{{Quote|Be on your guard. Sil Tantoo is known for his treachery. He has crossed every intelligence service in the galaxy at least once.|[[Akaavi Spar]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:OK" />}}
'''Sil Tantoo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|rodian]] and "safehouse broker" who was based in [[Anchorhead]].<ref name="TOR:OK" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> he helped [[Jemala Ha'rangir]] and [[Ora Nem]] hide from [[Heta Kol]] and the [[Hidden Chain]], but didn't do a very good job as [[Sanlo Raal]] and the rest of [[Raal's Regulators]] managed to find Jemala and Ora. Sil also informed the [[Alliance Commander]] of where Jemala and Ora were, although this was after the commander had already spoken to [[Ogee (Jawa)|Ogee]].<ref name="TOR:OK" />
